scope: Three day composites and one castle night composite; all visible material families reviewed. This does not complete all-stage night or interaction-state coverage.
method: Fixed rectangular castle-camera patches, unmasked pixels, sRGB decoded to linear luminance. HSV saturation is diagnostic, not perceptual quality. Regions may contain painted shading and mixed pixels; ratios are not target grade values.

visual_findings.observation: Yellow-green highlights stand apart from adjacent teal/olive foliage in arrival and castle.
visual_findings.next_action: Trial selective leaf highlight compression and hue alignment; preserve cream petals and leaf detail.

visual_findings.observation: Pale rounded foreground leaves contrast strongly with dark fine-grained rear hedges; the repeated border reads as a separate asset family.
visual_findings.next_action: Compare same-species foliage; grade individual clumps and reduce repetitive placement, preserving foreground depth.

visual_findings.observation: Large opaque surfaces remain nearly day-bright while landscape darkens; the discontinuity is broader than saturation.
visual_findings.next_action: Separate ambient surfaces from windows, gold glints and doorway accents; test an opt-in night grade without painting over approved art.

visual_findings.observation: Swing and slide remain conspicuously bright against the dark lawn.
visual_findings.next_action: Align ambient response with nearby props; retain readable interaction accents.

visual_findings.observation: Mapped source patches show greater arrival saturation and cooler hue. This is regional evidence, not a whole-stage score.
visual_findings.next_action: Compare matched foliage materials across the transition before applying a local grade.

visual_findings.observation: Some overlay clouds are rounder and higher-contrast than the distant cloud field; pale mountains and clouds still provide useful depth.
visual_findings.next_action: Review cloud edge, opacity and value at rest and maximum drift; do not globally desaturate sky or mountain art.

visual_findings.observation: Broad yellow-green lawn and dark teal planting beds have strong material separation; sparse animated blades can look pasted on.
visual_findings.next_action: Check blade base and highlight colors against their exact underlying lawn at every pose; retain path contrast.

visual_findings.observation: Water shares the ambient night change, but white interaction ripples attract disproportionate attention in still captures.
visual_findings.next_action: Review the complete alpha/fade cycle and contact feedback before adjusting highlight intensity.

visual_findings.observation: Paths remain legible and cooler pink stone separates from grass; no global recolor is justified by this review.
visual_findings.next_action: Preserve clear left castle approach; inspect lighting continuity around healed plant masks and water banks.

visual_findings.material: Flowers, berries and new large plants
visual_findings.observation: Purple/pink/cream accents provide useful variety. New rosette and berry-fan highlights have already been compressed, but adjacent older assets remain inconsistent.
visual_findings.next_action: Use approved nearby material references for each asset; never force all flower hues or species to match.

visual_findings.observation: Bright actor colors support visibility, but the actor moves between these day/night captures; fixed pixel differences cannot isolate actor lighting.
visual_findings.next_action: Capture matched actor positions and interactions in all stages; preserve protected source colors.

visual_findings.observation: HUD is intentionally screen-space and bright; it must be evaluated for readability independently from landscape lighting.
visual_findings.next_action: Review focus rings, pointers and feedback across day/night and touch states on the target device.

correction_order: Bellflower and pale foreground foliage trials
Shared night ambient response with separate emissive accents
rollback: No runtime or artwork changed by this audit. Future corrections must be opt-in derived variants with original sources retained.
remaining: Arrival and meadow matched night composites
All material corrections and visual comparisons
